name: Australian South Sea Islander Community Foundation Scholarship
provider: QUT and Australian South Sea Islander Community Foundation
summary: An equity scholarship for Australian South Sea Islander students in QUT undergraduate study, applied for through the Equity Scholarships Scheme.
key: Valued at up to $5,000, offered only in the Semester 1 round each year.
who: Australian South Sea Islanders who meet QUT's entry requirements for undergraduate study.
how: Apply through the QUT Equity Scholarships Scheme in the Semester 1 round.
catches: You can get only one award from the Equity Scholarships Scheme each year.
